title: MV Issue of Player Character shaking when adjusting movement speed while using Yanfly's Core Engine plugin

posts.author: Power_Intterrales
posts.body:
I have observed that when setting the Move Speed below 4 in Karberus's Speed Manager plugin while Yanfly's Core Engine plugin is enabled, the player character experiences a shaking effect. This issue can also occur when setting
$gamePlayer.setMoveSpeed(x)
directly without using Karberus's Speed Manager plugin.
However, disabling Yanfly's Core Engine plugin allows the character to move normally without any shaking.
I would appreciate any insights or recommendations on how to enable the player character to move at a low speed without experiencing this shaking effect while still benefiting from Yanfly's Core Engine plugin.
Link :
- Karberus's Speed Manager plugin :
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/speed-manager.52639/
- Yanfly's Core Engine plugin :
http://www.yanfly.moe/wiki/Core_Engine_(YEP)
